	if Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		and Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		return
	end

	local MousePosition = Input.Position
	local ClosePosition = Close.AbsolutePosition
	local CloseSize = Close.AbsoluteSize

	if MousePosition.X >= ClosePosition.X
		and MousePosition.X <= ClosePosition.X + CloseSize.X
		and MousePosition.Y >= ClosePosition.Y
		and MousePosition.Y <= ClosePosition.Y + CloseSize.Y then
		return
	end

	Dragging = true
	DragStart = Input.Position
	StartPosition = Main.Position

	Input.Changed:Connect(function()

		if Input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
			Dragging = false
		end

	end)

end)

	if not Dragging then
		return
	end

	if Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		and Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		return
	end

	local Delta = Input.Position - DragStart

	Main.Position = UDim2.new(
		StartPosition.X.Scale,
		StartPosition.X.Offset + Delta.X,
		StartPosition.Y.Scale,
		StartPosition.Y.Offset + Delta.Y
	)

--========================================================--
-- F3X DISCOVERY
--========================================================--

local Remote = nil
local F3XTool = nil

local function FindF3X()

	Remote = nil
	F3XTool = nil

	for _, v in Player:GetDescendants() do

		if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then

			F3XTool = v.Parent

			local SyncAPI = F3XTool:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI")

			if SyncAPI then

				local Endpoint = SyncAPI:FindFirstChild("ServerEndpoint")

				if Endpoint then
					Remote = Endpoint
					break
				end

			end

		end

	end

	if not Remote then

		for _, v in ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants() do

			if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then

				F3XTool = v.Parent

				local SyncAPI = F3XTool:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI")

				if SyncAPI then

					local Endpoint = SyncAPI:FindFirstChild("ServerEndpoint")

					if Endpoint then
						Remote = Endpoint
						break
					end

				end

			end

		end

	end

	if Remote then

		Status.Text = "F3X: READY"
		Status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 255, 130)

	else

		Status.Text = "F3X: NOT FOUND"
		Status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)

	end

	return Remote

end

FindF3X()

--========================================================--
-- REAL F3X INVOKE
--========================================================--

local function F3X(Arguments)

	if not Remote then
		FindF3X()
	end

	if not Remote then

		warn("BLUEKIDD F3X: ServerEndpoint not found")

		return false

	end

	local Success, Result = pcall(function()

		return Remote:InvokeServer(unpack(Arguments))

	end)

	if not Success then

		warn("BLUEKIDD F3X ERROR:", Result)

		FindF3X()

		return false

	end

	return true

end

local CurrentSky = nil
local DiscoRunning = false
local TrippyRunning = false

--========================================================--
-- FIND NEW F3X PART
--========================================================--

local function CapturePartsAt(CF)

	local Existing = {}

	for _, Part in workspace:GetDescendants() do

		if Part:IsA("BasePart") then

			if (Part.Position - CF.Position).Magnitude < 0.15 then
				Existing[Part] = true
			end

		end

	end

	return Existing

end

local function WaitForNewPart(CF, Existing)

	for Attempt = 1, 40 do

		for _, Part in workspace:GetDescendants() do

			if Part:IsA("BasePart") then

				if not Existing[Part]
					and (Part.Position - CF.Position).Magnitude < 0.25 then

					return Part

				end

			end

		end

		task.wait(0.05)

	end

	return nil

end

--========================================================--
-- CREATE F3X SKYBOX

local function CreateSkybox(Id)

	local Character = Player.Character

	if not Character then
		return
	end

	local Root = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not Root then
		return
	end

	DiscoRunning = false
	TrippyRunning = false

	local Position = Vector3.new(
		math.floor(Root.Position.X),
		math.floor(Root.Position.Y) + 6,
		math.floor(Root.Position.Z)
	)

	local CF = CFrame.new(Position)

	local Existing = CapturePartsAt(CF)

	CreatePart(CF, workspace)

	local SkyPart = WaitForNewPart(
		CF,
		Existing
	)

	if not SkyPart then

		warn(
			"BLUEKIDD: F3X created the part but it could not be located"
		)

		return

	end

	CurrentSky = SkyPart

	SetName(
		SkyPart,
		"BLUEKIDD_SKYBOX"
	)

	AddMesh(SkyPart)

	SetMesh(
		SkyPart,
		SKY_MESH
	)

	SetTexture(
		SkyPart,
		Id
	)

	MeshResize(
		SkyPart,
		Vector3.new(
			7200,
			7200,
			7200
		)
	)

	SetLocked(
		SkyPart,
		true
	)

	Status.Text = "SKYBOX: READY"

local function getGuiParent()
    local ok, cg = pcall(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
    if ok and cg then return cg end
    return LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

-- THEME
local Theme = {
    Bg=Color3.fromRGB(22,22,30), PanelBg=Color3.fromRGB(32,32,44),
    RowBg=Color3.fromRGB(42,42,56), RowHover=Color3.fromRGB(58,58,78),

local Connections = {}
local Killed = false
local function track(c) table.insert(Connections, c); return c end
local function kill()
    if Killed then return end
    Killed = true
    for _, c in ipairs(Connections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("SniperCombatCam") end)
    pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("SniperMisc") end)
    local p = getGuiParent()

            g:Destroy()
        end
    end
    pcall(function()
        UIS.ModalEnabled = false
        UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true
        UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
    end)

end
_G.__SniperKill = kill

-- CONFIG
local Config = {
    ESP = {
        Enabled = true, NPCs = true, Players = true,
        Box = true, Name = true, Distance = true, Health = true,
        MaxDist = 3000,
        NPCColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 60),
        EnemyColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70),
        TeamColor = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 130),
    },
    Aimbot = {

    },

        NoClip = false,
    },

}

-- HELPERS
local function getRoot()
    local c = LP.Character
    return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
local function localPos()
    local r = getRoot()
    return r and r.Position or nil
end
local function viewportCenter()
    local vp = Cam and Cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920,1080)
    return Vector2.new(vp.X*0.5, vp.Y*0.5)
end

-- NPC SCANNER
local NPCContainer = nil
local function getNPCContainer()
    if NPCContainer and NPCContainer.Parent then return NPCContainer end
    local hl = WS:FindFirstChild("Highlight")
    if hl then
        local en = hl:FindFirstChild("Enemy")
        if en then
            local hh = en:FindFirstChild("HighlightHolder")
            if hh then NPCContainer = hh; return hh end
        end
    end
    return nil
end
local function resolveChar(inst)
    if not inst then return nil end
    if inst:IsA("Highlight") then
        local ad = inst.Adornee
        if not ad then return nil end
        if ad:IsA("Model") then return ad end
        if ad:IsA("BasePart") then return ad:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") end
        return nil
    end
    if inst:IsA("Model") then
        if inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return inst end
        return nil
    end
    if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
        return inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    end
    return nil
end
local function scanNPCs()
    local list = {}
    local container = getNPCContainer()
    if not container then return list end
    local seen = {}
    local function tryAdd(char)
        if not char or seen[char] then return end
        seen[char] = true
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char.PrimaryPart
        if hum and head and root then
            table.insert(list, {
                Character=char, Humanoid=hum, Head=head, Root=root,
                IsNPC=true, Label="NPC",
            })
        end
    end
    for _, d in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do tryAdd(resolveChar(d)) end
    for _, c in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do tryAdd(resolveChar(c)) end
    return list
end
local function scanPlayers()
    local list = {}
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LP then
            local char = plr.Character
            if char then
                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hum and head and root and hum.Health > 0 then
                    table.insert(list, {
                        Character=char, Humanoid=hum, Head=head, Root=root,
                        Player=plr, IsNPC=false, Label=plr.Name, Team=plr.Team,
                    })
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return list
end
local function scanAll()
    local list = {}
    for _, t in ipairs(scanNPCs()) do table.insert(list, t) end
    for _, t in ipairs(scanPlayers()) do table.insert(list, t) end
    return list
end

-- WALL CHECK
local function hasLineOfSight(fromPos, toPos, target)
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    local ignore = {}
    if LP.Character then table.insert(ignore, LP.Character) end
    if target and target.Character then table.insert(ignore, target.Character) end
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
    local result = WS:Raycast(fromPos, toPos - fromPos, params)
    return result == nil
end

-- ESP
local ESPGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ESPGui.Name = "SniperESP"
ESPGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ESPGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
ESPGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
ESPGui.DisplayOrder = 998
ESPGui.Parent = getGuiParent()

local espDrawings = {}
local function createESP()
    local d = {}
    d.hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
    d.hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    d.hl.FillTransparency = 0.55
    d.hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
    d.hl.Enabled = false
    d.hl.Parent = ESPGui

    d.box = Instance.new("Frame")
    d.box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    d.box.BorderSizePixel = 0
    d.box.Visible = false
    d.box.Parent = ESPGui
    local st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    st.Thickness = 1.5
    st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
    st.Parent = d.box
    d.stroke = st

    d.name = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    d.name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    d.name.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
    d.name.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    d.name.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    d.name.TextSize = 13
    d.name.Visible = false
    d.name.Parent = ESPGui

    d.dist = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    d.dist.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    d.dist.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220,220,220)
    d.dist.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    d.dist.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    d.dist.TextSize = 11
    d.dist.Visible = false
    d.dist.Parent = ESPGui

    d.hpBg = Instance.new("Frame")
    d.hpBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30)
    d.hpBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    d.hpBg.Visible = false
    d.hpBg.Parent = ESPGui

    d.hpFill = Instance.new("Frame")
    d.hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90,220,90)
    d.hpFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    d.hpFill.Visible = false
    d.hpFill.Parent = ESPGui

    return d
end
local function hideESP(d)
    d.hl.Enabled = false
    d.box.Visible = false
    d.name.Visible = false
    d.dist.Visible = false
    d.hpBg.Visible = false
    d.hpFill.Visible = false
end
local function getESP(char)
    local d = espDrawings[char]
    if not d then d = createESP(); espDrawings[char] = d end
    return d
end
local function updateESP()
    if not Cam then Cam = WS.CurrentCamera end
    if not Cam then return end
    if not Config.ESP.Enabled then
        for _, d in pairs(espDrawings) do hideESP(d) end
        return
    end
    local lPos = localPos()
    if not lPos then
        for _, d in pairs(espDrawings) do hideESP(d) end
        return
    end
    local seen = {}
    for _, t in ipairs(scanAll()) do
        if (t.IsNPC and Config.ESP.NPCs)
        or (not t.IsNPC and Config.ESP.Players) then
            seen[t.Character] = true
            local d = getESP(t.Character)
            local dist = (t.Root.Position - lPos).Magnitude
            if dist <= Config.ESP.MaxDist then
                local top = t.Head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
                local bot = t.Root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                local ts, on1 = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(top)
                local bs, on2 = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(bot)
                if on1 and on2 and ts.Z > 0 and bs.Z > 0 then
                    local h = math.abs(bs.Y - ts.Y)
                    local w = math.max(h * 0.55, 12)
                    local x = ts.X - w * 0.5
                    local y = ts.Y
                    local col
                    if t.IsNPC then
                        col = Config.ESP.NPCColor
                    elseif t.Player and LP.Team and t.Team
                    and t.Team == LP.Team then
                        col = Config.ESP.TeamColor
                    else
                        col = Config.ESP.EnemyColor
                    end
                    d.hl.Adornee = t.Character
                    d.hl.FillColor = col
                    d.hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                    d.hl.Enabled = true
                    d.box.Visible = Config.ESP.Box
                    d.box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
                    d.box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
                    d.stroke.Color = col
                    d.name.Visible = Config.ESP.Name
                    d.name.Text = t.IsNPC and "NPC" or t.Label
                    d.name.TextColor3 = col
                    d.name.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ts.X - 100, y - 18)
                    d.name.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 14)
                    d.name.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
                    d.dist.Visible = Config.ESP.Distance
                    d.dist.Text = string.format("[%dm]", math.floor(dist))
                    d.dist.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ts.X - 100, y + h + 2)
                    d.dist.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 12)
                    d.dist.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
                    if Config.ESP.Health and t.Humanoid then
                        local hp = math.clamp(
                            t.Humanoid.Health / math.max(t.Humanoid.MaxHealth, 1),
                            0, 1)
                        d.hpBg.Visible = true
                        d.hpBg.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x - 6, y)
                        d.hpBg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, h)
                        d.hpFill.Visible = true
                        d.hpFill.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x - 6, y + h * (1 - hp))
                        d.hpFill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, h * hp)
                        d.hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(
                            math.floor(255*(1-hp)), math.floor(255*hp), 0)
                    else
                        d.hpBg.Visible = false
                        d.hpFill.Visible = false
                    end
                else hideESP(d) end
            else hideESP(d) end
        end
    end
    for char, d in pairs(espDrawings) do
        if not seen[char] or not char.Parent then
            hideESP(d)
            if not char.Parent then
                for _, part in pairs(d) do
                    if typeof(part) == "Instance" then
                        pcall(function() part:Destroy() end)
                    end
                end
                espDrawings[char] = nil
            end
        end
    end
end

-- AIMBOT
local function aimCameraAt(target, part, smoothness)
    if not target or not part then return false end
    local cam = WS.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return false end
    local goal = CFrame.new(cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position)
    cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(goal, smoothness)
    return true
end

local function findBestTarget()
    if not Cam then Cam = WS.CurrentCamera end
    local center = viewportCenter()
    local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
    local lPos = localPos()
    if not lPos then return nil end
    local camPos = Cam.CFrame.Position
    for _, t in ipairs(scanAll()) do
        if t.IsNPC or not (LP.Team and t.Team and t.Team == LP.Team) then
            local part = Config.Aimbot.TargetPart == "Head" and t.Head or t.Root
            local sp, on = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
            if on and sp.Z > 0 then
                local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
                if d <= Config.Aimbot.FOV and d < bestD then
                    -- Wall check: cast a ray from the camera to the target part
                    local pass = true
                    if Config.Aimbot.WallCheck then
                        pass = hasLineOfSight(camPos, part.Position, t)
                    end
                    if pass then
                        bestD = d; best = t
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function updateAimbot()
    if not Config.Aimbot.Enabled then return end
    if not UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then return end
    if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
    local target = findBestTarget()
    if not target then return end
    local part = Config.Aimbot.TargetPart == "Head" and target.Head or target.Root
    aimCameraAt(target, part, Config.Aimbot.Smoothness)

-- MISC (flight state)
local FlightBV = nil
local function flightStart()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hum then return end
    hum.PlatformStand = true
    if not FlightBV or FlightBV.Parent ~= hrp then
        if FlightBV then FlightBV:Destroy() end
        FlightBV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        FlightBV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
        FlightBV.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        FlightBV.P = 1000
        FlightBV.Parent = hrp
    end
end
local function flightStop()
    if FlightBV then FlightBV:Destroy(); FlightBV = nil end
    local char = LP.Character
    if char then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
    end
end

local function updateMisc()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum then return end

    -- WalkSpeed
    if Config.Misc.WalkSpeed.Enabled then
        hum.WalkSpeed = Config.Misc.WalkSpeed.Value
    end

    -- JumpPower
    if Config.Misc.JumpPower.Enabled then
        hum.UseJumpPower = true
        hum.JumpPower = Config.Misc.JumpPower.Value
    end

    -- NoClip
    if Config.Misc.NoClip then
        for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
                p.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end

    -- Flight
    if Config.Misc.Flight.Enabled then
        if not FlightBV or not hrp then
            flightStart()
        end
        if FlightBV and hrp then
            local cam = WS.CurrentCamera
            if cam then
                local move = Vector3.zero
                local speed = Config.Misc.Flight.Speed
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then move = move + cam.CFrame.LookVector end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then move = move - cam.CFrame.LookVector end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then move = move - cam.CFrame.RightVector end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then move = move + cam.CFrame.RightVector end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then move = move + Vector3.new(0,1,0) end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then move = move - Vector3.new(0,1,0) end
                if move.Magnitude > 0 then move = move.Unit * speed end
                FlightBV.Velocity = move
            end
        end
    else
        if FlightBV then flightStop() end
    end
end

function GetClosestTarget(...)
    local Args = {...}
    if not Args then return nil end
    --
    local Target, Closest = nil, math.huge
    for Index, Value in next, Players.GetPlayers(Players) do
        if LocalPlayer == Value then continue end
        --
        local Character = Value.Character
        if not Character then continue end
        --
        local Head = game.FindFirstChild(Character, 'Head')
        if not Head then return Target end
        --
        local Humanoid = game.FindFirstChildOfClass(Character, 'Humanoid')
        if not Humanoid or Humanoid.Health <= 0 then continue end
        --
        local Obscuring = Camera.GetPartsObscuringTarget(Camera, {Args[1], Head.Position}, {Character, LocalPlayer.Character})
        if #Obscuring > 0 then continue end
        --
        local Vector, OnScreen = Camera.WorldToViewportPoint(Camera, Head.Position)
        if not OnScreen then continue end
        --
        local Distance = (Vector2.new(Vector.X, Vector.Y) - UserInputService.GetMouseLocation(UserInputService)).Magnitude
        if Distance < Closest then Closest, Target = Distance, Head end
    end
    --
    return Target
end

-- > Connections
for Index, Value in next, getgc() do
    if typeof(Value) ~= 'function' then continue end

            local Target = GetClosestTarget(Args[1]:GetBase().Tip.WorldPosition)
            if not Target then return Original(table.unpack(Args)) end

local function createSlider(parent, text, min, max, defaultVal, callback)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 64)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Config.SecondaryColor
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
    frame.Parent = parent
    
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    c.Parent = frame
    
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 55)
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5
    stroke.Parent = frame
    
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 28)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 6)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = text
    lbl.TextColor3 = Config.TextColor
    lbl.TextSize = 13
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.Parent = frame
    
    local valLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    valLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 75, 0, 28)
    valLbl.Position = UDim2.new(1, -85, 0, 6)
    valLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    valLbl.Text = tostring(defaultVal)
    valLbl.TextColor3 = Config.AccentColor
    valLbl.TextSize = 13
    valLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    valLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    valLbl.Parent = frame
    
    local sliderBg = Instance.new("Frame")
    sliderBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 8)
    sliderBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 40)
    sliderBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40)
    sliderBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sliderBg.Parent = frame
    
    local sbgc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    sbgc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    sbgc.Parent = sliderBg
    
    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp((defaultVal - min) / (max - min), 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Config.AccentColor
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Parent = sliderBg
    
    local fc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    fc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    fc.Parent = fill
    
    local draggingSlider = false
    local function updateValue(input)
        local pos = math.clamp((input.Position.X - sliderBg.AbsolutePosition.X) / sliderBg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        local val = math.floor(min + (max - min) * pos)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(pos, 0, 1, 0)
        valLbl.Text = tostring(val)
        callback(val)
    end
    
    sliderBg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            draggingSlider = true
            updateValue(input)
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            draggingSlider = false
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if draggingSlider and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            updateValue(input)
        end
    end)
    return frame
end

        -- Speed Modifier Logic with Lag Fix (>300 CFrame boost & normal base speed reset)
        if Config.SpeedEnabled then
            local targetSpeed = Config.SpeedValue * Config.SpeedMultiplier
            if targetSpeed > 300 then
                hum.WalkSpeed = 300
                if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                    hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + (hum.MoveDirection * (targetSpeed - 300) * dt)
                end
            else
                hum.WalkSpeed = targetSpeed
            end
        else
            hum.WalkSpeed = 16
        end

        if Config.JumpEnabled then
            hum.JumpPower = Config.JumpValue
        end

        if Config.BhopEnabled then
            if hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
                hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
            end
        end

        if Config.SpinbotEnabled then
            hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Config.SpinbotSpeed), 0)
        end

        if Config.WalkOnWaterEnabled then
            waterPlatform.Position = Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, 0, hrp.Position.Z)
            waterPlatform.CanCollide = true
        else
            waterPlatform.CanCollide = false
        end

        if Config.NoclipEnabled then
            for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end

        if Config.HitboxEnabled then
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then

                    if Config.HitboxInf then

                    else
                        targetHrp.Size = Vector3.new(Config.HitboxSize, Config.HitboxSize, Config.HitboxSize)
                    end
                    targetHrp.Transparency = 0.7
                    targetHrp.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end

        if Config.AimbotEnabled then
            local closestPlayer = nil
            local shortestDist = math.huge
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    local dist = (hrp.Position - p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist < shortestDist then
                        shortestDist = dist
                        closestPlayer = p
                    end
                end
            end
            if closestPlayer and closestPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, closestPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
            end
        end

        if Config.StarfallEnabled then
            starfallEmitter.Position = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 30, 0)
            starfallEmitter.Rate = Config.StarfallCount
            starfallEmitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(Config.StarfallColor)
        else

        end

        if Config.RainEnabled then
            rainEmitter.Position = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 30, 0)
            rainEmitter.Rate = Config.RainAmount
            rainEmitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(Config.RainColor)
        else
            rainEmitter.Rate = 0
        end
    end

    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
            local charModel = p.Character
            if Config.ESPEnabled then
                if not charModel:FindFirstChild("SalchibloxESPHighlight") then

    end

    end
end)

local function GetAllEntities()
    local entities = {}
    local searchedContainers = {
        Workspace:FindFirstChild("Entities"),
        Workspace:FindFirstChild("Monsters"),
        Workspace:FindFirstChild("Spawns"),
        Workspace
    }

    local function ScanContainer(container)
        if not container then return end
        for _, item in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Model") then
                if item:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or item:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or item:FindFirstChild("Head") then
                    if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(item) then
                        table.insert(entities, item)
                    end
                else
                    ScanContainer(item)
                end
            elseif item:IsA("Folder") then
                ScanContainer(item)
            elseif item:IsA("BasePart") and item.Name:lower():find("monster") then
                table.insert(entities, item)
            end
        end
    end

    for _, c in ipairs(searchedContainers) do
        if c then ScanContainer(c) end
    end

    local unique = {}
    local hash = {}
    for _, ent in ipairs(entities) do
        if not hash[ent] then
            hash[ent] = true
            table.insert(unique, ent)
        end
    end

    return unique
end

    end

    if DownedModule then
        local success, downedResult = pcall(function()
            local moduleTable = require(DownedModule)
            if type(moduleTable) == "function" then
                return moduleTable(player) or moduleTable(char)
            elseif type(moduleTable) == "table" then
                if moduleTable.IsDowned then return moduleTable.IsDowned(player) end
                if moduleTable.Check then return moduleTable.Check(player) end
                if moduleTable[player] or moduleTable[player.Name] then return true end
            end
            return false
        end)
        if success and downedResult == true then

-- Real-time RenderStepped update loop for direction-accurate tracking arrows
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not ArrowToMonstersActive then 
        ClearArrows()
        return 
    end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local head = char and (char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera

    if not head or not cam then
        ClearArrows()
        return
    end

    local entities = GetAllEntities()
    local currentEntities = {}

    for idx, ent in ipairs(entities) do
        currentEntities[ent] = true
        local targetPart = ent:IsA("BasePart") and ent or (ent:IsA("Model") and (ent.PrimaryPart or ent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or ent:FindFirstChild("Head") or ent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")))

        if targetPart then
            local arrowGui = ArrowCache[ent]
            if not arrowGui or not arrowGui.Parent then
                arrowGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                arrowGui.Name = "MonsterArrowGui"
                arrowGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
                arrowGui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40)
                arrowGui.Adornee = head
                arrowGui.Parent = MainGui

                local arrowImg = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                arrowImg.Name = "Arrow"
                arrowImg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24)
                arrowImg.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -12, 0.5, -12)
                arrowImg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                arrowImg.Image = "rbxassetid://6034818372"
                arrowImg.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
                arrowImg.Parent = arrowGui

                local distLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                distLbl.Name = "Dist"
                distLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
                distLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -10)
                distLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                distLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                distLbl.TextSize = 9
                distLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                distLbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
                distLbl.Parent = arrowGui

                ArrowCache[ent] = arrowGui
            end

            -- Alternates arrows on the sides of player head to avoid overlapping
            local isEven = (idx % 2 == 0)
            local sideMultiplier = isEven and 1 or -1
            local stackOffset = math.floor((idx - 1) / 2) * 1.2
            local xOffset = sideMultiplier * (2.2 + stackOffset)
            local yOffset = 1.5

            arrowGui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(xOffset, yOffset, 0)

            -- ACCURATE POINT-AT-TARGET ROTATION MATH
            local targetPos = targetPart.Position
            local dist = math.floor((targetPos - head.Position).Magnitude)
            
            -- Compute angle using camera-relative coordinate space
            local localDir = cam.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(targetPos - cam.CFrame.Position)
            local angle = math.atan2(-localDir.X, -localDir.Z)

            local arrowImg = arrowGui:FindFirstChild("Arrow")
            local distLbl = arrowGui:FindFirstChild("Dist")

            if arrowImg then
                arrowImg.Rotation = math.deg(angle)
                if dist < 30 then
                    arrowImg.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40)
                elseif dist < 70 then
                    arrowImg.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 30)
                else
                    arrowImg.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 120)
                end
            end

            if distLbl then
                distLbl.Text = tostring(dist) .. "m"
            end
        end
    end

    -- Clean up despawned entity arrows
    for ent, arrowGui in pairs(ArrowCache) do
        if not currentEntities[ent] or not ent.Parent then
            if arrowGui and arrowGui.Parent then arrowGui:Destroy() end
            ArrowCache[ent] = nil
        end
    end
end)

local function TeleportToNearestAlivePlayer()
    if IsPlayerDowned(LocalPlayer) then return end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end

    local nearest, minDist = nil, math.huge
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
            local pHum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local pHrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if pHum and pHum.Health > 0 and pHrp and not IsPlayerDowned(p) then
                local dist = (pHrp.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < minDist then
                    minDist = dist
                    nearest = pHrp
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if nearest then
        hrp.CFrame = nearest.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
        Notify("downed tp", "teleported to nearest alive player: " .. nearest.Parent.Name:lower())
    end
end

    local mainMap = mapFolder and mapFolder:FindFirstChild("Main")
